questions.question: At which ground did Gugu Ngcobo record their career-best innings (33*, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval, against Heat on 2022/02/06.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most 5-Wicket Hauls' in the 17/18 season (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Raisibe Ntozakhe holds it, with a total of 2.

questions.question: How many sixes separate the all-time #1 (Sunette Loubser) and #2 (Susan Benade) six-hitters (combined T20 + List A) in the 11/12 season?
questions.explanation: Sunette Loubser: 9 — Susan Benade: 8 — a gap of 1.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Best Bowling Figures in an Innings' in the 20/21 season (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Jade de Figueiredo holds it with 5-10, a joint record shared with Sthasiselo Ndebele.

questions.question: Which team has finished runner-up more times than any other in this database (7), despite winning the title only twice in that span?
questions.explanation: Lions finished runner-up 7 times across List A and T20 Division 1 between 2012/13 and 2025/26, but won the title only twice.

questions.question: Who has achieved the century and 3 wickets in a match double more times, Alicia Smith or Susan Benade?
questions.explanation: Alicia Smith: 1 times. Susan Benade: 2 times.
